QUANTIZER_SEMANTICS_UNCHANGED.DEQUANT_DTYPE: codes*scale in float32, then cast to cache state dtype
QUANTIZER_SEMANTICS_UNCHANGED.GROUP_SEMANTICS: one scale for all 128 V values at fixed [B,H,K]
QUANTIZER_SEMANTICS_UNCHANGED.MAP_BACK_POSITION: Q(S@R;s_R)@R.T after dequantization, before state intervention
QUANTIZER_SEMANTICS_UNCHANGED.QUANTIZE_DEQUANT_ORDER: float32 input -> scale -> round -> clamp -> codes*scale -> cache dtype
QUANTIZER_SEMANTICS_UNCHANGED.ROTATION_POSITION: S_R=S@R before scale selection and quantization

kernel_audit.DECODE_CAST_POINTS: q/k/v loaded to FP32; output cast to v dtype; state remains FP32
kernel_audit.DECODE_INPUT_DTYPE: q/k/v model dtype; activated decay and beta float32
kernel_audit.DECODE_QUANTIZER_LOCATION: outside kernel, after each token transition
kernel_audit.DECODE_STATE_CARRY_SEMANTICS: previous float32 state consumed directly and next float32 state returned
kernel_audit.DECODE_VALUE_ROTATION_LOCATION: v -> vR before kernel; output mapped by R.T; state remains rotated until boundary conversion
kernel_audit.PACKED_PREFILL_ACCUMULATION_DTYPE: mixed Triton FP32 accumulation; final state float32
kernel_audit.PACKED_PREFILL_CAST_POINTS: q/k/v loaded to FP32 inside Triton; output cast to v dtype; state emitted FP32
kernel_audit.PACKED_PREFILL_QUANTIZER_LOCATION: outside kernel, once after packed prefill returns
kernel_audit.PACKED_PREFILL_SCAN_TYPE: chunk scan with parallel intra-chunk solve
kernel_audit.PACKED_PREFILL_VALUE_ROTATION_LOCATION: v -> vR immediately before live KDA operator; state stored in rotated V coordinates
kernel_audit.PACKED_VS_DECODE_DIFFERENCES: chunk_kda uses 64-token chunk scan and parallel intra-chunk algebra; decode uses direct sequential fused recurrence with one carried FP32 state
